title: Prepare graphene samples
action: Generate initial atomic coordinates for square graphene sheets of side lengths L = 10, 20, 40, 80 Å (C–C bond length 1.42 Å) with fixed boundary conditions on left and right edge columns and periodic boundary in y. For isotopic disorder conditions (0%, 5%, 10%, 20% ¹⁴C), randomly substitute the required fraction of ¹²C atoms with ¹⁴C in the initial structure. Produce LAMMPS data files.
description: Create all required initial configurations and LAMMPS input structures for the 11 conditions. This step must be executed before MD simulations.

title: Run MD simulations and compute per-run Young's modulus
action: For each condition (size L, temperature T, isotopic disorder), run 100 independent LAMMPS simulations using pair_style airebo, with time step 0.5 fs, 5e5 equilibration and 5e5 production steps. Extract the thermal mean-square vibration amplitude ⟨σ²⟩ from the z-coordinate trajectories of free atoms, then compute Young's modulus Y per run using the continuum-plate formula Y = 0.3×(S/h³)×(k_B T/⟨σ²⟩) with h = 3.35 Å, S = L², and k_B = 1.380649e-23 J/K. Collect all per-run Y values in a structured evidence file.
description: Executes the full MD workload and saves the raw per-run modulus values to a JSON evidence file. This file documents that all simulations were performed; it is not directly scored but is required for traceability.
output_schema: JSON object mapping condition identifier to an array of 100 floating-point Y values (in TPa). Example: {"L=40_T=300_D0": [1.05, 1.12, ...]}

title: Final averaged Young's modulus
action: From the per-run data generated in step_02, average the 100 Y values for each condition and write the results to youngs_modulus_results.csv.
description: The CSV file listing the averaged Young's modulus for every required condition. This is the primary scored artifact; its values are checked against hidden gold references and its trends are verified.
output_schema: CSV with header: Condition,Youngs_modulus_TPa. Contains 11 rows corresponding to the 11 required conditions: size series (L=10,20,40,80 at T=300 K, 0% disorder), temperature series (L=40 Å at T=100,300,500 K, 0% disorder), and disorder series (L=40 Å, T=300 K, disorder 0%,5%,10%,20%). Condition is a string; Youngs_modulus_TPa is a float.
